text:
Gold Price in 1982
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1982, the LBMA gold price rose 18.1% between 1982-01-29 ($387) and 1982-12-30 ($457). The highest sampled price was $457 in December and the lowest was $318 in June. The mean of these observations was $378. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
